mutant: L155 string ' observes the stated behaviour: the finding does not reproduce' emptied
group: A reason whose cause class is carried by status/observed beside it (NOT_REPRODUCED), unlike UNVERIFIABLE [21]/[22].
grounds: The emptied sentence ' observes the stated behaviour: the finding does not reproduce' restates what the adjacent fields of the same Verification already carry (status NOT_REPRODUCED, probe id, observed verdict, all always set on this return). A NOT_REPRODUCED finding has no evidence (Verification.evidence() is '' unless CONFIRMED), so Finding.blocks is False, its gate row is passed and informational, and the developer's retry prompt prints only passed-False rows: the reason is never shown to anyone as an instruction. Unlike the UNVERIFIABLE reasons [21]/[22], where the reason is the only statement of the cause, here the cause class is the status. The sentence is also inaccurate on one path (verdict INDETERMINATE gets it; re-measured by me with observation-indeterminate.py: NOT_REPRODUCED, observed 'INDETERMINATE'), so pinning it would pin a false sentence. I tried to refute: no reader parses it.
